correctness.rationale: From independent positive alpha-stable S,Sprime, the Tonelli/Laplace identity E[(1+uS/Sprime)^-1]=(1+u^alpha)^-1 holds for u>0. Differentiating the Bernoulli cumulant integral gives Hprime(t)=logistic(alpha t), hence H(t)=alpha^-1 log((1+e^(alpha t))/2). Midpoint Riemann sums yield the same scaled log-MGF Lambda as alpha Bin(N,1/2), and bounded tilted variance plus Chernoff give left/right strict log tails with common rate I. The strictly monotone rate on either side of alpha/2 converts any hypothetical macroscopic quantile separation, including endpoint probability levels, into a contradictory ordering of CDFs. The proof covers real fixed alpha, floor m_N and generalized inverses. Independent numerical quadrature checked the fractional cumulant identity for alpha=0.3,0.5,2/3,0.85 and several positive/negative tilts; finite small-N transport computations only corroborate, not prove asymptotics.
